reasoning_content:
Exit 143 (SIGTERM) — maybe pkill -f "GradleDaemon" matched the shell command itself? `pkill -f` matches the entire command line. Since the shell command contains the string "GradleDaemon", pkill killed its own shell! A classic footgun (self-destruct). This is exactly the process management pitfall that was warned about.

Let me check the state: was sed executed? The command was a chain using `;`, so... after pkill killed the shell, everything stopped. Let me redo this carefully.
